contexts: 24-bed inpatient hospice with a community palliative care team
condolence card at two weeks and volunteer call at six weeks
no bereavement risk screening at present
reading: Uptake is shaped at three points: whether the offer reaches the family, when it arrives, and whether its form suits the person. The retrieved records link proactive personal contact to higher uptake, leave timing unsettled, and show that risk screening and text messages change who takes up support rather than simply how many. Men, families who need an interpreter and families living far away sit at the edge of every current offer. The rapid review has to be organised around these decision points so the board can see which change addresses which gap.
